title: Rollout planner
hints: Normalise every field as you read it: serial .strip().upper(), ring .strip().lower(), os_version .strip(). Use (device.get(k) or "") so a missing key and None behave like an empty string.
Integer ceiling division is (n * pct + 99) // 100. Validate pcts with any(a > b for a, b in zip(pcts, pcts[1:])) and pcts[-1] == 100 before computing anything.
partition_devices: pre-create {name: [] for name in ring_names}, keep a seen set for duplicates (check it before skip_reason), and sort each ring's list plus the skipped list at the end.

plan_rollout: keep a running day counter across rings; for each ring walk cumulative_targets(len(serials), pcts) and take serials[previous:target], then set previous = target. The date is start + timedelta(days=day - 1).
